notes: T-23 PR-17 PR-23: one restriction rule set evaluated against one request by the shared esuiss-restriction engine; the expect of a case is the answer every path gives: the server's limits and verdict, work-bindings-core natively, WebAssembly in Node and browsers, and uniffi in Swift
a rule set is {schema, policies} as Cedar text; a request carries Cedar entity UIDs and the context object and entity array as JSON text handed to the engine unchanged

rule sets compile under the esuiss-restriction default limits narrowed to 64 policies (PR-23 item 2 (a)); a rule set that does not compile is restriction_compile_refused with the crate code as code_detail (PR-23 item 3)

deny names the matching forbid policies; an input over a limit or outside the schema and an evaluation error deny with no policy and attention true (PR-17 item 3, PR-23 item 4); no_objection is not a permission (PR-17 item 2)

errors.policies:
@id("overflow") forbid(principal, action, resource) when { context.amount * 1000000000000 < 0 };
@id("owner-assurance") forbid(principal, action, resource) when { resource has owner && resource.owner.assurance < 1 };
